moments.title: Rain delays England vs Pakistan Test
moments.blurb: Day two of the first Test between England and Pakistan at Headingley is currently delayed by rain, following the start of the three-match series yesterday.

angles.name: Rainy Day Cricket
angles.copy: Another day, another rain delay at Headingley for England vs Pakistan. Time to crack open the biscuits and hope for a break in the clouds! 🏏🌧️

angles.name: Test Series Underway
angles.copy: The Test series against Pakistan is officially underway! Shame the weather isn't playing ball on Day 2 at Headingley. Who's watching when it finally starts?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins tomorrow, Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: New Season Hype
angles.copy: It's BACK! The Premier League season kicks off tomorrow. Who are you tipping for the title, and who's facing the drop?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Coventry City to open the new Premier League season tomorrow night! A real baptism of fire for the Championship winners. Game on!

moments.title: WSL pioneers Connected Ball technology
moments.blurb: The Barclays Women's Super League (WSL) is set to become the first football league globally to implement groundbreaking Connected Ball technology, with Nike and Sportable rolling it out this September.

angles.name: WSL Innovation
angles.copy: Massive news for women's football! The WSL is leading the way with new Connected Ball technology, offering real-time insights for players and fans. This is a game-changer!

angles.name: Future of Football
angles.copy: Connected Ball technology in the WSL? Yes please! Imagine the stats, the analysis, the fan experience. Women's football continues to innovate.

moments.title: British boccia player Alex Medley wins World Gold
moments.blurb: British boccia player Alex Medley, a 21-year-old sports scholar from the University of Stirling, has won a gold medal at the World Boccia Challenger in Poznan, Poland.

angles.name: Boccia Gold for Britain
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to 21-year-old Alex Medley for bagging a gold medal at the World Boccia Challenger! What an incredible achievement for the British sports scholar.

angles.name: Scottish Sporting Hero
angles.copy: Shout out to Stirling University's Alex Medley, bringing home World Gold in Boccia! A fantastic moment for Scottish and British sport.

moments.title: We Out Here Festival kicks off in Dorset
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's curated We Out Here Festival, celebrating soul, hip hop, house, jazz and more, begins its four-day run today in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset.

angles.name: Dorset Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is ON! If you're lucky enough to have tickets for Gilles Peterson's sold-out celebration of music in Dorset, enjoy every moment!

angles.name: Gilles Peterson's Vision
angles.copy: From soul to electronica, We Out Here Festival promises four days of incredible genre-hopping music. Who's ready for some serious vibes?

angles.name: Live Music Weekend
angles.copy: Another fantastic UK festival starting today! Trentham Live promises a great weekend of music in Staffordshire. Make some noise!
